claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise how easy the comb is to use and how quickly it heats up.
Many customers say it effectively straightens hair and tames frizz, leaving hair smooth and shiny.
Some reviewers report it did not work well, especially on thick or curly hair, with flimsy teeth that pull hair.
A few users mention issues with the temperature controls, such as limited settings or buttons easily pressed accidentally.
Several reviewers highlight its good value and affordability.
